name: Packleader enrages the Bloodmage's summons after a Howl (#1920)
contract: Packleader 504290 reads 'Casting Howl spell now enrages your summons, increasing their damage dealt by 10% for 8 sec.' Its aura 42 has ProcFlags 0, so SpellMgr creates no proc entry and Howl casts never dispatch trigger 504289. That child is native SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS with aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, 10%, for 8000 ms. The shared Howl family mask also matches Blood Craving 800780, so a source-specific CheckProc must reject that non-Howl. The test checks that negative control, then the payload aura and amount on a controlled summon, plus an unrelated player's summon as an ownership control. Night Hunter's Howl 501682 is the Howl cast; its Cursed Form marker 524861 is fixtured directly.

steps.label: SETUP: the Bloodmage's controlled Imp is present
The other player summons a controlled Imp
Let the other 10-second Imp summon finish
SETUP: the other player's controlled Imp is present
SETUP: the Packleader passive is active
Fixture the Cursed Form marker required by Night Hunter's Howl
The controlled summon has no Packleader payload before Howl
The other player's summon has no Packleader payload before Howl
Blood Craving shares a Howl family flag but is not a Howl
Blood Craving does not trigger Packleader
Allow the shared global cooldown to expire
A Howl applies Packleader to the Bloodmage's controlled summon
The Howl does not buff another player's summon
Packleader applies its authored 10% damage bonus
